# Developer Environment Requirements Quality Checklist: Project Foundation and Developer Environment

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements in the developer environment foundation spec. Checks whether the requirements are complete, clear, consistent, measurable and covered. It does not test whether the implementation works.
**Created**: 2026-10-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the requirements for the start, stop and test commands complete, including the command names and what each one reports on success? [Completeness, Spec FR-001, FR-003, FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the mechanism for explicitly requesting data removal on stop defined, or only described as "unless explicitly requested"? [Gap, Spec FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are health requirements defined for the data store, including what "healthy" means and how it is reported? [Completeness, Spec FR-001, US1 scenario 1]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for re-running the start command when the stack is partially started or in an unknown state? [Coverage, Gap, Spec US1 scenario 2]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for how the test command behaves when the stack is stopped? [Completeness, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements for the contributor workflow (setup, running checks, branching, opening a change) defined in enough detail to follow without outside help? [Completeness, Spec FR-012, US3 scenario 3]
- [ ] CHK007 Are minimum versions for each prerequisite specified, or are the prerequisites only named? [Gap, Spec Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is "standard developer laptop" in SC-002 defined with measurable hardware or resource limits? [Ambiguity, Spec SC-002]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "working local stack skeleton" defined with observable criteria, rather than as a general description? [Clarity, Spec Input]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "clean clone" defined by an explicit list of assumed tools and prerequisites? [Clarity, Spec Assumptions, US1]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the lint and test failure reporting requirements in FR-005 quantified for every tool that produces output, not only in general terms? [Clarity, Spec FR-005]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "likely secrets" in FR-010 defined with the file types and patterns the check must cover? [Ambiguity, Spec FR-010]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "documented" in FR-011 and FR-012 defined with a minimum set of README content? [Clarity, Spec FR-011, FR-012]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the term "stack service" used consistently across the user stories, FR-002, SC-002 and the Key Entities section? [Terminology, Spec US1, FR-002, SC-002, Key Entities]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 Do the references to "every stack service" in US1 and SC-002 agree with the single-service scope set in FR-002 and the Clarifications section? [Consistency, Spec US1, SC-002, FR-002]
- [ ] CHK016 Do FR-004 (local checks) and FR-006 (CI checks) define the same set of lint and test checks? [Consistency, Spec FR-004, FR-006]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the handling of missing environment values consistent between the edge case ("MUST NOT start with a silent default for secrets") and the assumption that "default local values are safe"? [Conflict, Spec Edge Cases, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the 2-minute target in SC-003 defined for runs that need the stack and runs that do not? [Consistency, Spec SC-003]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 Is the number of trial runs behind SC-006's "100% of trial runs" specified? [Measurability, Spec SC-006]
- [ ] CHK020 Can the "every stack service healthy within 5 minutes" requirement be objectively measured given how health is defined? [Measurability, Spec SC-002, FR-001]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the pass condition for CI on the empty skeleton (FR-007, SC-004) defined in measurable terms? [Measurability, Spec FR-007, SC-004]
- [ ] CHK022 Can "no steps outside the README" (FR-011) be objectively checked against a defined list of steps? [Measurability, Spec FR-011]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the vector search capability in US1 scenario 4 defined by an observable behavior rather than a capability label? [Measurability, Spec US1 scenario 4, FR-002]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for port conflicts, including which ports are required and how they are changed? [Coverage, Spec FR-013, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Are recovery requirements defined for a start that fails after some services have already started? [Recovery, Gap, Spec FR-001, FR-003]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the distinction between tests that need the stack and tests that do not defined clearly enough to apply to each test? [Clarity, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 Are requirements defined for the first run, when no real environment file exists yet? [Coverage, Spec FR-008, FR-013]
- [ ] CHK028 Does the spec say whether CI must bring up the stack, or only run lint and tests? [Gap, Spec FR-006, FR-007]

## Non-Functional and Security Requirements

- [ ] CHK029 Is the scope of the automated secret check defined, including whether it runs locally at commit time, in CI, or both? [Gap, Spec FR-010, SC-006]
- [ ] CHK030 Are least-privilege requirements for local credentials stated in the spec, as the constitution requires? [Gap, Constitution XII]
- [ ] CHK031 Does the spec define what must be absent from the public repository, such as private infrastructure and real environment files? [Completeness, Spec FR-009, FR-014]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK032 Is the assumption that the CI service is free for public projects backed by a requirement or a named dependency? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions, Constitution VI]
- [ ] CHK033 Are the constitution's free-tier constraints (Principle VI) referenced or restated in the spec where they apply? [Traceability, Constitution VI]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the assumption that tool choices are deferred to planning reflected in requirements that planning must satisfy? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions, Notes]

## Ambiguities and Conflicts

- [ ] CHK035 Is the term "data store" in FR-002 defined well enough that a reviewer can tell which capabilities are required and which are optional? [Ambiguity, Spec FR-002]
- [ ] CHK036 Is it clear whether the stop command must leave named volumes or other stored data in place by default? [Ambiguity, Spec FR-003, US1 scenario 3]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
